system.description:
Choose a skill with the tag [Blade] [Spear] [Hafted] [Martial Arts] tag from the skills you have acquired.
Remove the [Blade] [Spear] [Hafted] [Martial Arts] tag from the selected skill. This effect lasts until the end of the scenario.

Through inspiration and practice, you can develop unique talents and use weapon-type-limited feats with other weapons.
